quotes.text: The TB Tools patch-review reference says to count new-side lines from the raw unified diff and place inline comments on changed added lines. This keeps Phabricator anchors tied to the reviewed patch. An unchanged checkout line can explain a finding, but it is context rather than an inline anchor. This is documented review guidance, not evidence that a particular comment was posted correctly.
